text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Influenced by other Umamusume, Hishi 
Miracle suddenly finds her motivation. 
However, she gets carried away and hurts 
her leg.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Forced to rest for a while. She gradually 
starts slacking off... and eventually 
stops coming to training.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
The Trainer waits patiently with 
unwavering faith. Barely managing to turn 
over a new leaf, Hishi Miracle returns.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
However, she lacks the courage to 
apologize honestly. She vowed to make up 
for this setback little by little through 
her actions.
